contributions.anchor: Form A 'Total Contributions (to line 1 of report): 15.00'
contributions.detail: The single Form A row (Kevin Bryan, 9/14/24, 15.00) sums to 15.00 = the schedule's own printed total = the cover's CUMULATIVE line-1 cell (15.00). The cover's This-Report line-1 cell is a slashed zero and Last Report is 15.00, so this December-5 final report added nothing; the schedule restates the whole cycle, hence cumulative scope, not period scope. 3-line form variant, so there is no separate <=$50 aggregate line and no line-1/line-2 residual. No in-kind label appears anywhere on the sheet; the monetary-only convention closes exactly (a monetary-plus-in-kind reading is identical here because there are no in-kind items).

expenditures.anchor: Form B 'Total Expenditures (to line 2 of report)' printed as a slashed zero glyph
expenditures.detail: Form B (p127) is present and its 23-row printed grid is entirely blank. The filer wrote a slashed-zero glyph on the total line outside the grid; under the zero-glyph ruling that DENOTES zero, so zero rows sum to 0 = the printed schedule total = the cover's line-2 cells (Last/This/Cumulative all slashed zeros). No expenditure row exists to be missed.

escalation_note: One 900 dpi tight --value crop on p126 to settle which x-band is the first DATA row (the band immediately after the header band is a blank spacer band, per the 2026-08-18 addendum s2.2 warning).

126.measure_note: Landscape sheet rendered portrait, so rows advance LEFT-TO-RIGHT (axis x) and the column bands are the horizontal rules. Rules measured on the RAW 200 dpi poppler render (not a deskewed copy): row rules taken from the dark-column profile inside the amount-column strip y=6-15.5pct (threshold 0.8) so the ~0.4deg page skew cannot smear them; column rules from the dark-row profile over x=12-90pct. rowbands.py returned only 5 v_rules on this sheet because the skew defeats a whole-page column profile. The detector's first three bands ([6.21,8.56] outer margin, [8.56,11.62] HEADER, [11.62,14.79] blank spacer) were TRIMMED before index-aligning; the 23 bands stored are the printed data rows, so row N resolves to rows[N-1]. The amount column's outer edge is not detected (faint), so cell starts at 5.20 which the proof crop confirms sits inside the table. PROOF (2026-08-18): this side has exactly one transcribed row, so it is both the first and the last and was proved directly. Crop pct:14.79,5.20,3.15,10.66@p126 at 900 dpi --value rendered the handwritten figure 15.00 -- the amount recorded for row 1. The two neighbouring bands were also cropped as controls: pct:11.62,5.20,3.17,10.66@p126 rendered an EMPTY cell (the spacer band) and pct:8.56,5.20,3.06,10.66@p126 the header, confirming the trim is right and the indexing is not off by one.

contributions.note: Form A prints a single Address column; only city/state are carried (PRIVACY: the street line printed on the form is deliberately not transcribed). Filer wrote the city in lower case ('ogden'); normalized capitalization only.

notes: Brian Rowley, County Commission Seat C, 2024 December-5 FINAL report, handwritten. p125 = cover (3-line variant), p126 = Form A, p127 = Form B. Cover line-1 This-Report and all of line 2 are slashed-zero glyphs (transcribed as 0 by the zero-glyph ruling); the cover's Address block is BLACKED OUT BY THE COUNTY (redaction by the county, not left empty by the filer). This filing is NOT the known Rowley filer-arithmetic specimen: it has one row and one page and no page SUBTOTAL line, so no delta arises. Both sides close on the CUMULATIVE column, so this is not an incremental filing.
